scope: Final worker/experiment/review file inventory after additive operational closeout review. Named copied-input directories are excluded; other frozen source snapshots remain included. Artifact count is not job count. All allowed packets remain on disk and are bound by their own manifests/seals.
qualifications: Per-job limits only; no aggregate memory or complete OS concurrency proof. Finite controls are not infinite-distribution proofs. Closeout source review is static, not future execution certification.
